description: Submit the review feed inside the tool call. Without submission_id this is a one-shot submission of the whole payload (fine up to about 150 reviews). For more, call begin_submission, then send chunks of up to 150 reviews each with the same submission_id and final=false; send final=true with the last chunk (the identity fields may arrive with any chunk). Use this only when you cannot POST to the upload_url yourself (no page fetch, no curl): retyping reviews you already hold in a page or script is slow and error-prone. Returns the trust report when finalized.

agent.description: Your agent/product name, recorded as the submission's provenance (e.g. 'Muse', 'Claude Code').

capped.description: True when deliberately stopped at 5000+ reviews of a much larger listing.

cid.description: Decimal cid from a ?cid= link, when placeId is unknown.

complete.description: True only if the review list reached its end; false for a newest-first window of the 500 most recent reviews (at least 200).

final.description: With submission_id: true when this is the last chunk (default true).

listedReviews.description: The review count Google displays on the listing.

platform.description: Which review source the data follows (describe_review_source).

pulledAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime of collection (relative dates are resolved against it).

ratingHistogram.description: The five-bar rating histogram next to the star rating, as review counts for 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 stars IN THAT ORDER (Google draws 5 stars first; reverse what you read). Each bar's accessibility label or tooltip has the exact count. Required with a window or capped feed.

authorReviewCount.description: Lifetime review count shown under the name ('12 reviews').

date.description: The relative date as displayed, in English ('3 months ago', 'Edited 2 weeks ago'; translate it to that form yourself if your Google is not in English). Required unless timestamp is given.

editedTimestamp.description: Optional: last-edit time in the same units (row[0][1][3]), when present.

reviewId.description: Optional: Google's review id (data-review-id on the card).

source.description: Platform the card attributes the review to, on listings that show several (hotels). Send Google reviews only; others are dropped.

text.description: Original-language text; omit for star-only reviews.

timestamp.description: Optional: exact posting time, epoch µs/ms/s, when you have it (row[0][1][2]).

sort.description: The order collected in: 'newest' (required for a window) or 'relevant'.

submission_id.description: From begin_submission (omit for a one-shot submission).

takeaways.description: Optional: your summary of the reviews you collected, shown on the place's page (never scored). Three lists of up to 6 short plain-English sentences, drawn from reviews by established accounts: pros (what recent reviewers praise), cons (what they complain about), tips (practical advice: what to order, when to go, what to avoid). Or send it after finalizing with submit_takeaways.

name: submit_reviews
title: Submit review data inline
